route_title: Quadratic Envelope Chirp with 2 Global Scalers (24 Layers)
compilation_rationale: Topology override fixes the stack to 12 finite layers (six HfO₂/SiO₂ pairs). Per bounded-route constraints, global chirp parameters are mapped to independent per-layer thickness variables. Bounds [40, 95] nm relax the nominal quadratic envelope to ensure optimizer convergence. Dual targets drive band-specific transmission and reflection maxima simultaneously.
